MORE:
In reference to letter dated 07.11.2026 pursuant to Regulation 33(Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that Board of Directors in its meeting held today i.e 14.11.2026 approved the un-audited standalone financial results of the Company for the quarter/half year ended 30.09.2026. 

The board meeting commenced on 14.11.2026 at 06:00 pm and concluded at 06:30 pm.
